verdict.rationale: Langfuse docs explicitly describe an LLM Playground for interactively testing prompts, plus versioning and linking prompts to traces to compare performance, directly matching the story (langfuse-docs-7, langfuse-docs-20, langfuse-docs-9, langfuse-docs-12).
